en.t: A talent for making one's way in the world.
At that, I could only give a bitter smile.

units.source_text: 自己居然有謀生之道的本領！

en.t: To think that I had a talent for making my way in the world!

units.source_text: 像我這種畏懼人類，唯恐避之不及，常常掩飾敷衍的人，

en.t: Someone like me, who fears people, wants only to avoid them, and is always covering things up and evading them,

units.source_text: 難道與俗話所說的「人不犯我，我不犯人」這種狡猾的處世訓條如出一轍？

en.t: was I really no different from that sly worldly maxim people quote, "If no one troubles me, I trouble no one"?

units.source_text: 啊，人類根本不瞭解彼此，明明完全誤讀了對方，

en.t: Ah, people never understand one another at all; even while completely misreading the other person,

units.source_text: 還以為對方是自己唯一的摯友，一輩子覺察不到，

en.t: they go on believing that person is their one true friend, and never notice it their whole lives,

units.source_text: 等對方死了，不是還痛哭流涕念悼詞嗎？

en.t: and when the other person dies, do they not still weep bitterly and read a funeral tribute?
